svg.title: Pothole Reporter India coverage map
svg.desc: Pothole Reporter covers all 28 states and 8 Union Territories. The CC0 boundary follows the Survey of India boundary standard and includes the mainland territorial outline, Lakshadweep, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. No government endorsement is implied.
svg.metadata: Boundary source: DataMeet India community, india-composite.geojson (CC0), commit 5ed214bf77788f99066e3542cccd4a52cb042896, input SHA-256 5e44c39b18aa8fe57267d8018fa4ad4a10eaa3aa4cb7cb7382a1813ef8eb8c53. Source: https://github.com/datameet/maps/blob/5ed214bf77788f99066e3542cccd4a52cb042896/Country/india-composite.geojson . The source states that it includes disputed territories in accordance with the official Survey of India boundary. Geometry was simplified to 0.025 degrees for this 320-pixel README display. Coverage shading and annotations: Pothole Reporter. No government endorsement is implied.

g.aria-label: India mainland and claimed territorial outline
